feed_title: Pillow Dog Bed Mattress, Grey Herringbone and Faux Fur, Medium 100 x 65cm and Large 120 x 80cm, Washable Cover | PawLunova Hawkshead
descriptionHtml:
Faux fur over fibre. Grey herringbone. Soft on purpose.

Hawkshead is an open pillow dog bed in grey herringbone with a faux-fur sleeping surface, in Medium (100 × 65 × 20cm) and Large (120 × 80 × 20cm).

Some dogs cannot lie down without rearranging things first. They scratch at it, gather a fold up under the chest, turn twice and drop into the heap they have made. On something firm with nothing that moves, they stand up and start again.

Virgin fibre gives under them, so there is something to push into. The faux fur adds pile on top, which is the part they are pawing at.

What they get

  • Soft, not firm: Virgin fibre cushions the sleeping space. This is not a memory foam mattress.
  • Faux fur where they sleep: Grey herringbone outside, faux fur on the surface they lie on.
  • A non-slip base: It stays where you put it rather than skating across a hard floor.
  • Leather handles and two open sizes: 100 × 65cm or 120 × 80cm, both 20cm deep with all four sides clear.

Best for: Sprawlers who prefer soft fibre cushioning, and hard floors where a bed travels.

Why it is worth the money

£79 for the Medium and £89 for the Large buys texture rather than depth, and that is the honest trade. The money sits in a herringbone outer, a faux-fur surface, leather handles and a base that grips. And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Hawkshead is the soft option and it is priced as one. There is no foam core and no no-flatten guarantee on it, because virgin fibre is cushioning rather than support. A heavy dog is better off on one of our foam mattresses.

Size and fit

SizeListed dimensions (cm)
Medium100 × 65 × 20
Large120 × 80 × 20

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Take the cover off and follow the sewn-in washing instructions. Let it air-dry fully before you put it back on. The leather handles have their own care instructions.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

Compare their measured length against 100cm on the Medium or 120cm on the Large.

Is there any foam in it?

No. Virgin fibre cushions this one, which is softer and not the same as foam.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

It is an open fibre-filled pillow bed with no sides and a base that does not slide. Your vet can advise on what surface suits them.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The covers come off and go in the machine to the sewn-in instructions.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Then send it back. That is what the 100 nights are for. We collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
